chapter: Fellow musicians: Kirk, Bunk, Parker, McShann
title: Never played with Kirk; the St. Louis night with Ben Thigpen
summary: Lovett tells how Ben Thigpen begged him not to show him up in St. Louis, and he got the crowd throwing hats anyway.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Andy Kirk, Baby?
Couldn't get Ben Thigpen out of the way?
He was a good one too. I --
Well, you know, -- go ahead, Baby.
Well, I went to St. Louis one time and Ben was playing there.

I walked in there man and Ben -- it was intermission when I walked in, see. Ben came off the band stand and he shook my hand and said, 'Well Lovett, I'm sure glad to see you man, but I'm going to tell you one thing. Please don't go up there and show me up, man.' I said, 'Man, I didn't come here for nothing like that'. I said, 'I don't want to play anyway, you understand what I mean'.
So I went up there and played man and people started throwing hats up and everything and all that stuff and he came back down and said, 'Didn't I tell you not to do that'.
I said, 'Ben, I didn't try to show you up. I was only playing Lovett style, that's all.' So that was all that happened there.
